findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11(P) Person In Charge. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall ensure that: (P) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the PERSON IN CHARGE, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD, as specified under 2-201.11(A).

On arrival the PIC was unaware of any reporting agreements or similar paperwork that had been filled out or signed by food handlers. The PIC called the food manager who stated correct procedures but stated that they had not known that verification/paperwork was required. Blank copies were found in the public health folder in the filing cabinet. Fresh copies of the SCDPH reporting agreements were given during this inspection and a follow up scheduled for 10 days to ensure compliance with the code. Ensure that all needed paperwork is available at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment:
(REREAT) 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use.

On arrival the hand sink next to the three part sink is observed blocked with a hand cart. As the inspector and PIC walked into the space the PIC moved the cart into the walk in cooler prior to inspector prompting. This shows that they know that it should not be in this location normally. The situation was discussed with the PIC during this inspection. Ensure that all hand sinks remain accessible at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.11: Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. 

On arrival there was no soap available for use at the hand sink next to the three part sink. Soap was provided to correct. Ensure that all hand sinks are properly supplied at all times.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. 

On arrival the hand sink in the back of the facility was blocked by a cart. When discussed, the PIC indicated that they used the hand sink in the front when needed. This is too far for when dishes are being cleaned. This was stated and the cart moved to correct. Ensure that all hand sinks are maintained accessible at all times to facilitate consistent use.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.11: (A) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be: (C) Cleaned at least every 4 hours. 

Rollers used for tornados are observed soiled during this inspection. Service had been halted prior to this inspection and these should have been cleaned at that time. They were cleaned during this inspection to correct the violation. Ensure that the food contact surfaces are cleaned at the end of shift each day.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. 

There is not a Certified Food Protection Manager on site at the time of this inspection. Ensure that a CFPM is available at all times the facility is in operation.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. 

The front hand sink is without paper towels during this inspection. Napkins were brought over to work until more paper towels can be acquired.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple nozzles on the soda fountain machine are observed soiled. The nozzles were cleaned/sanitized during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
(REPEAT x2) 4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

Test strips are not available for the quat sanitizer used in the facility. Follow up in two weeks for compliance.

findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.comment:
Facility continues to have priority foundation violations regarding test strip availability. Operator on arrival unable to answer questions regarding sanitization practices including what type of sanitizer is used to indicate to suppliers which type of test strips are needed. Facility is using quaternary ammonia (quat) sanitizer. Inspector discussed these concerns with manager and discussed the need for anyone working to understand which type of sanitizer is available and how to test concentrations at all times. Ensure that facility is in compliance with test-strip requirement and ensure that education is occurring internally so that all employees can verify food contact surfaces are being sanitized appropriately. 

2-102.11: Based on the RISKS inherent to the FOOD operation, PIC shall demonstrate knowledge by:  (A) Having no Priority Foundation items; (B) Being a CFM; OR (C) Responding correctly questions as they relate to the specific FOOD operation. The areas of knowledge include C1 through C16.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Facility uses quaternary ammonia sanitizer. No test strips are available. Test strips are on-order and an invoice is available. Operator has been to GFS and Sam's Club to find test strips. Operator states that none were available at either supplier. Test strips must be available at all times that food is being prepared. A second follow-up is being issues for 10-days to ensure compliance. This is a repeat violation for 10/26/2022 routine inspection performed by inspector AD.

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.comment:
Due to the presence of multiple priority foundation violations and the lack of certified food protection manger training, PIC has not demonstrated appropriate knowledge of food safety. Ensure PICs are knowledgeable and trained.
2-102.11: Based on the RISKS inherent to the FOOD operation, PIC shall demonstrate knowledge by:  (A) Having no Priority Foundation items; (B) Being a CFM; OR (C) Responding correctly questions as they relate to the specific FOOD operation. The areas of knowledge include C1 through C16. [Pf]

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
No Certified Food Protection Manager (CPFM) present at time of inspection. According to PIC, there is only one CPFM on staff. CFPMs must be present at all times that foods are prepared or served (for example, any time hot dogs are available on the rollers). Hire or train additional staff to be certified food protection managers.
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. [C]

findings.comment: Observed dirty knife on bar cutting board when no food service or prep has occurred recently. Instructed PIC to ensure equipment and utensils are cleaned after use. Knife was removed for cleaning during the inspection.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: Observed soiled microwave in bar area and mold growth in bar reach-in cooler. Advised PIC to clean as often as necessary to prevent soil accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11 (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: Observed vent hood in bar area to be soiled with accumulation of grease. Facility must be cleaned frequently enough to prevent soil accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.
